title: Standardizing a difference in sample means
description: You can follow the pooled spread calculation into Cohen's d.

steps.description: cohens_d weights each sample variance by its degrees of freedom. You take the square root after dividing by the combined degrees of freedom to obtain pooled_sd.

steps.question: Which subtraction determines the sign of the returned effect size?
steps.answer: The function subtracts b's mean from a's mean, then divides by pooled_sd.

steps.description: You call the function with A first and B second. The supplied output prints Cohen's d = 0.74.
The final statement separately formats the raw A-minus-B mean difference. You can distinguish that original-scale comparison from the standardized d value.
